page.title: Wellbeing
page.desc: Mood, journal and screening are private. None of this is sent to the Earth-bound queue.
animo.title: How are you feeling today?
animo.hint: One tap is enough. It is saved only on this device.
animo.chart.ariaMedia: Mood over the last {{dias}} days, average {{media}}
animo.unavailable.title: Daily mood unavailable
animo.unavailable.body: This device does not yet have the server version with mood logging.
animo.low.title: Today was a hard day
animo.low.body: Thank you for logging it. These self-regulation ideas may help; if you need to, talk to the onboard physician.
animo.shift.title: Different from your usual mood
animo.shift.body: Your mood today differs from your usual over the last two weeks.
animo.saved.title: Mood logged
animo.saved.body: It stays in your private history.
animo.empty: No entries yet. The first one will appear here.
diario.title: Personal journal
diario.hint: Secure local storage, disconnected from external telemetry.
diario.notePlaceholder: What's on your mind? Write it here…
diario.saved: Saved. The note stays on this device and is not sent anywhere.
diario.loadError.title: Notes could not be loaded
diario.loadError.body: The server did not respond. Your notes were not lost.
diario.empty: No notes yet. The first one you save will appear here.
avisos.title: Shared notices
avisos.hint: Only the onboard physician sees them, and only while you do not withdraw your consent. They never leave for Earth.
prefs.title: Your assistant
prefs.hint: Choose how you want it to talk to you. Only what you choose is saved.
prefs.saved: Saved. Recommendations will use this style.
voz.title: Voice assistant
voz.hint: Speak in turns. Each turn lasts up to 8 seconds and the response plays automatically.
voz.noAudio: No audio was detected. Try again.
voz.unavailable: The microphone is not available on this device.
voz.error: The turn could not be completed.
tamizaje.title: Mood screening (PHQ-2) and crisis protocol
tamizaje.hint: Last two weeks. Private result: it is not transmitted. This is a screening, not a diagnosis.
tamizaje.q.0: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
tamizaje.q3: Are you going through an acute psychological crisis or have you had thoughts of harming yourself?
tamizaje.q3.aria: Safety question about crisis or self-harm
tamizaje.crisis.yes: Yes, I need the immediate support protocol
tamizaje.o2.label: Cabin oxygen quality (% O₂, optional; if omitted, the ship's latest reading is used)
tamizaje.needConsent: Check the consent box to notify the onboard physician
tamizaje.res.crisis: Acute risk detected: follow the immediate steps for support and onboard environmental checks.
tamizaje.res.positive: Positive screening. This is not a diagnosis: it is worth discussing with the onboard physician.
tamizaje.o2.title: Cabin oxygen quality: {{valor}} % ({{nivel}})
tamizaje.o2.alert: Hypoxia or altered cabin O₂ can cause or worsen distress, confusion and acute psychological crisis.
tamizaje.o2.ok: Cabin oxygen within the nominal range.
tamizaje.share.title: Share with the onboard physician (optional and with your consent)
tamizaje.share.hint: Only the onboard physician or commander will see this notice. It does not share your personal journal or enter the Earth-bound queue.
tamizaje.shared.title: Notice shared with the onboard physician
tamizaje.shared.body: Status: {{estado}}. You can withdraw your consent at any time.
tamizaje.revoked: Consent revoked. The notice is no longer visible to the onboard physician.
tamizaje.consent: I authorize notifying the onboard physician so I can receive support in the cabin
tamizaje.note.placeholder: Optional short note for the physician (max. 280 characters)
tamizaje.note.aria: Optional note for the onboard physician
tamizaje.notify: Notify the physician with my consent
